description: This file defines the class DeployedSubpanelImplementation, which extends AbstractMetaDataImplementation and manages subpanel layout definitions for deployed modules in SuiteCRM. It handles loading, saving, and versioning of subpanel configurations, interacts with module metadata, and integrates with the SubPanelDefinitions class.

classes.name: DeployedSubpanelImplementation
classes.description: Class managing deployment handling of subpanels, including loading, saving, versioning, and integration with module definitions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the subpanel implementation, loading definition, and history.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Saves and deploys a new layout definition, updating history and cache.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the filepath for the subpanel metadata file based on parameters.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language associated with the subpanel.
